description: This file defines the interface for managing merged tables of references in a version control system. It includes declarations for creating, initializing iterators over, querying, and freeing merged table data structures, as well as functions to get index ranges and hash identifiers.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_new
methods.description: Creates a new merged table from an array of reference tables.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_init_ref_iterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to read references from the merged table.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_init_log_iterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to read logs from the merged table.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_max_update_index
methods.description: Returns the maximum update index covered by the merged table.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_min_update_index
methods.description: Returns the minimum update index covered by the merged table.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_free
methods.description: Releases memory associated with the merged table.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_hash_id
methods.description: Returns the hash ID of the merged table.
